name: Tripwire Canary

perks.name: Agile Bowstring
perks.desc:
Durable yet light bowstring.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Tactile String
perks.desc:
Stable, high-friction bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Elastic String
perks.desc:
Excellent snapback.
  •  Decreases accuracy
  •  Faster draw time
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Flexible String
perks.desc:
Light and easy to draw.
  •  Slightly faster draw time
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: High Tension String
perks.desc:
Tightly strung bow.
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly slower draw time
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Natural String
perks.desc:
Simple balanced string.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Polymer String
perks.desc:
Unbreakable bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly faster draw time

perks.name: Carbon Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Light and stable shaft material. 
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Compact Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Thinner arrows to increase nocking speed and weapon handling.
  •  Increases handling speed 
  •  Increases reload speed

perks.name: Fiberglass Arrow Shaft
perks.desc:
Heavy and consistent. 
  •  Greatly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly decreases stability

perks.name: Helical Fletching
perks.desc:
Aerodynamic and light. 
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Slightly increases stability

perks.name: Natural Fletching
perks.desc:
Feather-light with good control.
  •  Slightly decreases accuracy
  •  Greatly increases stability

perks.name: Straight Fletching
perks.desc:
Modern fletching for straight paths. 
  •  Increases accuracy

perks.name: Sneak Bow
perks.desc: Increases hold time and reload speed, and prevents radar pings from shooting while crouched.

perks.name: Shot Swap
perks.desc: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

perks.name: Rapid Hit
perks.desc: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.name: Perfect Float
perks.desc: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Archer's Tempo
perks.desc: Draw time decreases after every precision hit.

perks.name: Dragonfly
perks.desc: Precision kills create an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Opening Shot
perks.desc: Improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

perks.name: Explosive Head
perks.desc: Arrows explode after a short delay.

perks.name: Under-Over
perks.desc: Deals bonus damage to targets with overshields. Deals a small amount of bonus damage to combatant shields.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.desc: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

notes: pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Tripwire Canary is the newest arc combat bow. Hopefully it lives up to replace Arsenic Bite. It can roll the infamous roll of dragonfly and explosive head, with the newly buffed dragonfly it should feel really strong. Frenzy being the major source of damage can be paired with your choice of reload or draw time bonuses or the AoE of dragonfly. No choice is wrong from these options." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "In PvP lightweight bows are not the strongest choice. You can definitely make them work in either a swap build or by team-shooting with them. Opening shot is going to ensure a crit when you’re in the same postal code as your opponent, or you could go for flinch city and roll with explosive head. It’s a niche play style but you can build into it." Recommended MW - Draw Time.

Inspired by DMB PvE Podcast 44. First-choice PvE roll for general content. Shapeable. The Ambush origin trait is probably more for PvP than PvE, with the extra range, handling and 10% boost to damage for a few moments after combat starts or the Veist Stinger will provide the occasional fast reload and draw. The Lightweight frame provides +20 mobility and 6.25% boost to movement, which is always useful. As with all bows, get the draw time as low as possible with Elastic String, and then recover the lost accuracy with Fiberglass Arrow Shaft. For end-game content, in the first trait column, Archer's Tempo rewards crit hits with even faster draw time. Explosive Head not only adds bonus damage passively, but also disrupts overload Champions in fewer hits, when the mod is around. MW: Draw Time or Accuracy, with a damage-boosting (Minor, Major or Taken Spec) mod.
